summary:
Comprehensive implementation plan for:
1. Reusable Privacy Profiles (Ghost Cloak, Social Media Shield, Anti-Fraud Armor, and editable Custom Profiles) with per-app overrides.
2. Complete rewrite of Privacy Screen into intuitive categories (Hardware IDs, Graphics/GPU, Sensors/Battery, Network/WebRTC, System/Clipboard).
3. Total Identity Leak Root Deadman Switch (kills app, drops network via iptables, and fires high-priority alert notification).
4. True Zero-Exposure Hollow Drive (Linux 0700 private storage, hidden from Google Files/Photos).
5. Dashboard VPN/Proxy Quick Card with V2Ray/SOCKS/HTTP toggles.
6. Phone-style File Manager with category grid on top and assigned drives below.
